description: This file defines the EmployeeReportToController class in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the pre-rendering process for the 'Employee Report To' feature, retrieving reporting methods and setting up UI components and permissions for an employee based on their employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeReportToController
classes.description: Controller managing the setup and permissions for the 'Report To' employee feature, extending BaseViewEmployeeController.

methods.name: getReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with reporting methods, employee number, and permissions before rendering.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups used for capability permission checks, specifically 'supervisor' and 'subordinates'.
